support_request_draft.subject: Technical contract request — EGID historical daily EGX Feed API integration
support_request_draft.body: We are integrating an internal EGX market-data validation service and would like to use EGID as the authoritative source for historical daily data. Please provide the exact API contract and entitlement requirements for historical EGX equity data, specifically GET /api/DelayedFeed/GetSymbolHistories and GET /api/Feed/GetSymbolHistories. We need: (1) all query parameters, required/optional status, data types and exact symbol/instrument format; (2) date-range, daily interval/granularity, ordering, pagination and limit behavior; (3) the exact POST /api/Settings/GetToken request schema, required credential fields, token response field, token type/lifetime and the exact way the token is supplied to Feed/DelayedFeed requests; (4) the GetSymbolHistories response JSON schema, including security identity, session date/timestamp, Open, High, Low, Close, traded-share Volume, traded value/turnover and any final/closed field; (5) confirmation of which Volume field represents raw traded shares for the completed session, unadjusted and distinct from monetary turnover/value; (6) confirmation of the parameter/interval that returns one completed final daily EOD bar; (7) whether DelayedFeed entitlement is sufficient for historical daily data including 17 September 2026, or whether Feed entitlement is required; and (8) one redacted/sample historical daily response for an EGX equity such as EHDR. Please also advise the required commercial/technical entitlement for this historical API access. No live trading or order-entry capability is required.
